why_ai: Segmentation, journeys and send optimisation are software work AI-native platforms can absorb.
why_clarity: Billions of sends recur, but the open rate no longer measures whether messages work.
why_digital: Subscriber data in and messages out through SaaS sold entirely online.

why_ai: Text messaging litigation and enforceable sender rules keep legal accountability with humans.
why_clarity: Bulk sender rules define authentication, unsubscribe and complaint thresholds precisely.
why_digital: Consent records and registrations are data processed in software.

why_ai: Placement inference is a statistical problem, adversarial only because mailbox providers stay silent.
why_clarity: Billions of messages recur, but true placement is never directly observed.
why_digital: Engagement and authentication signals in, placement estimates out, all in software.

why_ai: Rebuilding segmentation on collected clicks and orders is modelling work software does directly.
why_clarity: The replacement metric is not yet agreed, so success is hard to check.
why_digital: Click and order data in, segments and send-time models out, all digital.

why_ai: Branch attribution is a computation on data the platform already holds.
why_clarity: Every brand builds similar journeys, but causal credit per branch is hard to verify.
why_digital: Journey logs and orders in, attribution reports out, all on screen.

why_ai: Reachability scoring is a well-posed prediction that software automates directly.
why_clarity: Subscriber states are defined and reactivation response is measurable at scale.
why_digital: Subscriber records in and segmented actions out, entirely in software.

why_ai: Pricing message fatigue is a closed-loop modelling problem inside the platform's own data.
why_clarity: The cost of an extra send shows up as unsubscribes over a year, not today.
why_digital: Messages, engagement and orders in one system, models out.

why_ai: Opaque mailbox and carrier filters add adversarial judgment, but both halves are inference problems.
why_clarity: Delivered is reported for every outcome, so true placement cannot be checked.
why_digital: Sending logs and reputation signals in, remediation out, entirely digital.

why_ai: Carrier relationships and the registration regime add some human gatekeeping to learnable code decoding.
why_clarity: Error codes conflate several outcomes, so filtering causes are hard to confirm.
why_digital: Error codes and registrations in, routing decisions out, all through software.

why_ai: A few hundred experts diagnose adversarial filters using individual craft and mailbox relationships.
why_clarity: Expertise is held in heads and transmitted informally, with placement still unobservable.
why_digital: Diagnosis and remediation happen on screen, often as remote consulting.

why_ai: Journey monitoring and documentation are automatable; campaign strategy keeps modest judgment.
why_clarity: Fifty journeys with no monitoring mean failures surface months late.
why_digital: Journey builders, calendars and dashboards are all screen work.
